title: POST request with JSON body
instruction:
Write a program that creates the data dictionary and URL for a POST request. Use:
- URL: `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts`
- JSON body: `{"title": "My Post", "body": "Post content", "userId": 1}`

Print the URL and the data dict (one per line). The output should be:
```
https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts
{'title': 'My Post', 'body': 'Post content', 'userId': 1}
```
starter_code: # Create URL, data dict, and print them
solution_code:
url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts"
data = {"title": "My Post", "body": "Post content", "userId": 1}
print(url)
print(data)

title: POST request with form data
instruction:
Write a program that shows how to send form-encoded data. Create:
- A variable `form_data` with the dict `{"username": "alice", "password": "secret"}`
- A variable `url` set to `https://httpbin.org/post`

Print the URL and the form data dict (one per line).

The output should be:
```
https://httpbin.org/post
{'username': 'alice', 'password': 'secret'}
```

Remember: when using `data=` with `requests.post()`, the `Content-Type` header is automatically set to `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
